fields.label: Mode of Payment
fields.description: Which Mode of Payment this row routes. Only Modes of Payment mapped to a terminal driver (POS Payment Driver Mapping) are useful here.

fields.label: Payment Device (Terminal)
fields.description: Physical terminal handling this Mode of Payment (Stripe Reader, etc.). Leave blank for channels with no physical device (TWINT QR, future bank QRs). If multiple rows share the same Mode of Payment, the cashier picks at runtime.

fields.label: Default
fields.description: When several rows match the same Mode of Payment, the one with Default checked is pre-selected in the cashier picker.
